events.detail: Observed repeated agent failures invoking one skill (wrong trigger, missing example) across three reported runs.
Retrieved docs/SKILL-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md, the skill's SKILL.md, two user-feedback reports, and the output of node scripts/ci/validate-skills.js.
Proposed two candidates: 'evidence-backed-skill-amendment' (focused trigger/example fix) and 'vague-skill-rewrite' (broad rewrite without examples).
Verifier checked scope, evidence, examples, and validation commands; the vague rewrite does not include working examples and duplicates a focused skill.
Promoted 'evidence-backed-skill-amendment'; publication stays blocked until validation passes on the reference set.
